claims: Sherlock Holmes is a fictional detective.
The deerstalker, pipe, and magnifying glass are definitively associated with Sherlock Holmes.
A deerstalker is a tweed cap with earflaps.
The deerstalker, pipe, and magnifying glass were featured as part of a group in the April 5, 2026, NYT Connections puzzle.
The group was categorized under "Parts of a Sherlock Holmes costume" along with the violin.
The deerstalker, pipe, and magnifying glass were popularized through early illustrations and stage adaptations of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's stories.
